items.title: What's at stake for Paramount, the Ellisons in Warner Bros. takeover bid
items.summary: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is facing some pushback from a collection of US attorneys general in its proposed acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD).
